data.name: Abaanah
data.gender_notes: Abaanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Abaanah is an Arabic name that means 'father's joy'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'ab' which means 'father' and 'anah' which means 'joy'. The name Abaanah carries the meaning “Father's joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Abaanah usually hope their child will grow to embody father's joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Abaanah is a name that symbolizes the joy and happiness that a father feels towards his child. It is a reminder of the special bond between a father and his daughter, and the love and care that he has for her.
data.etymology: Abaanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father's joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abaanah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
